title: Kedarkantha
description: Popular Himalayan winter snow trek offering 360-degree views of prominent Himalayan peaks.

title: Kalsubai Peak
description: Highest peak in Maharashtra, equipped with steel ladders along steep rock faces.

title: Ghanchakkar
description: One of the highest peaks in the Kalsubai region, known for dense jungle trails and rugged terrain.

title: Harishchandragad
description: Famous for the massive Kokankada cliff, Kedareshwar Cave with its massive Shivlinga, and Taramati Peak.

title: Rajgad Fort
description: Former Maratha capital for 26 years, featuring the Padmavati, Sanjeevani, and Suvela Machis alongside Padmavati Temple.

title: Sinhagad Fort
description: Historically rich fort famous for Tanaji Malusare's battle, Pune city views, and pitla-bhakri stops.

title: Ratangad
description: Known for its natural rock cavity called Nedhe (Eye of the Needle) and views of Bhandardara lake.

title: Hadsar Fort
description: Ancient hill fort near Junnar featuring rock-hewn steps pass, water cisterns, and a Shivling temple.

title: Bhairavgad Shirpunje
description: Situated near Shirpunje village in the Akole region, surrounded by deep forests and river valleys.

title: Harihar Fort
description: Renowned for its near-vertical 80-degree rock-cut steps leading up to the main entrance.

title: Pratapgad
description: Historic fort near Mahabaleshwar, site of the famous battle between Shivaji Maharaj and Afzal Khan.

title: Shivneri Fort
description: Birthplace of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, equipped with seven fortified gates and Badami Talav.

title: Dubergad
description: Lesser-known hill fort near Sinnar featuring water cisterns, plateau pastures, and ruined structures.

title: Ankai-Tankai Forts
description: Twin hill forts connected by a pass, famous for ancient Jain and Hindu rock-cut caves at their base.

title: Bhairavgad (Moroshi)
description: Adrenaline-heavy pinnacle trek requiring ropes to navigate exposed, worn rock-cut steps.

title: Mahuli Fort
description: Highest point in Thane district, popular among rock climbers for its towering pinnacle clusters.

title: Naneghat
description: Ancient trade route mountain pass famous for Brahmi script inscriptions and a stone toll collection pot.

title: Rajmachi Fort
description: Comprises twin fortress citadels (Shrivardhan and Manaranjan) overlooking the historical Borghat pass.

title: Raigad Fort
description: Capital of the Maratha Empire under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, featuring the Maha Darwaja and Hirkani Buruj.

title: Duke's Nose (Nagphani)
description: Distinct cliff near Khandala resembling a cobra's hood or the Duke of Wellington's nose.

title: Malang Gad
description: Hill fort featuring three levels, famous for the shrine of Haji Malang Baba at the base plateau.

title: Prabalgad
description: Massive flat-topped hill fort situated between Matheran and Panvel, adjacent to Kalavantin Durg.

title: Garbett Plateau
description: Vast, lush green plateau stretch extending towards the southeast border of Matheran.

title: Kalavantin Durg
description: Known for its iconic, steep hand-hewn steps winding around a pinnacle adjacent to Prabalgad.

title: Gorakhgad
description: Small pinnacle fort with steep rock-cut steps, large caves, and views of Machindragad.

title: Peb Fort (Vikatgad)
description: Offers ridge walks connecting to Matheran, featuring rock-cut caves and panoramic valley views.

title: Kothaligad (Peth Fort)
description: Features a unique funnel-shaped internal spiral staircase carved directly inside the rock pinnacle.

title: Karnala Fort
description: Located inside the Karnala Bird Sanctuary, marked by a distinct basalt thumbs-up pillar peak.

title: Sondai Fort
description: A minor watchtower fort near Karjat offering iron ladder climbs and views of Morbe Dam.

title: Devagiri (Daulatabad) Fort
description: Formidably fortified hill fortress famous for its dark zigzag defense pass (Bhulbhulaiya) and Chand Minar.

title: Kalu Waterfall
description: Kalu Waterfall is a magnificent 1,200-foot, five-tiered seasonal cascade located in the God's Valley near Malshej Ghat in Maharashtra,
